additional_info.subject: Issue Description
additional_info.body:
Hello,
During some tests with my Tesla, i had a problem to launch a RemoteStartTransction.
In SCB logs i can see:
2025-07-10T08:54:14.680961+00:00 [FW070005G1] sicharge-cp [daemon:info] bash[5996]: EcoG Error Reporting request: 10.20.17.100 - [10/Jul/20
+0000] "POST /sessions HTTP/1.1" 502 314 "" "Go-http-client/1.1" "{\"chargerID\":\"secc2300-
03117\",\"startTime\":1752137438653,\"endTime\":1752137650846,\"ending\":\"faulty\",\"outletType\":\"CCS\",\"outlet\":\"2\",\"errorCode\":39,\"err
- message timeout V2G09MSGSequence_V2GDINSession_V2GDINContractAuthentication\",\"evmac\":\"54.f8.f0.0c.e5.8f\",\"evccid\":\"54f8f00ce58f\"}
Why the vehicle was able to choose contract authentification while the charger has not this option please ?
Thank you
Best regards

additional_info.subject: ID0437590-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P8 312547889/14] Issue in launch of RemoteStartTransction CRM:02919000169
additional_info.body:
Hello Bastien, good afternoon.
What I can see is that there is not presented the Credit Card and the transaction is canceled:
As such you see the Error 39 which means that it failed during the last phase of the log:
"V2G - message timeout V2G09MSGSequence_V2GDINSession_V2GDINContractAuthentication
When you read this log, you should check the last one "ContractAuthentication", this means that in the DIN norm, the session failed during Authentication.
I hope this has answered to your question.
Best regards,
Francisco
